name: fct_client_operations
description: Tabla de hechos que consolidó operaciones financieras con los datos del cliente.
sql_query: SELECT o.operation_id, c.client_id, c.client_name, c.distributor_code, o.fund_code, o.amount, o.operation_date FROM ${ref('stg_operations')} o LEFT JOIN ${ref('stg_clients')} c ON o.client_id = c.client_id
